headline: Continental Controls rights issue at ₹10
summary: Continental Controls Ltd announced a rights issue of 1.96 crore shares at ₹10 per share to raise ₹19.66 crore. Record date is October 14, 2026.

headline: Nasscom addresses US green card suspension
summary: Nasscom clarifies that immigration and skilled talent mobility are distinct issues, noting Indian tech firms have reduced H-1B dependence.

headline: Oseaspre to seek EGM approval for capital hike
summary: Oseaspre Consultants plans an EGM on October 30, 2026, to approve raising authorised capital to ₹70 lakh and issuing shares on a preferential basis.
